reply_text:
*Found two merge-blocking issues:*

1. *Extension parsing contradicts the filename rules* — `src/extension.js:2`
   It takes the segment after the first dot and doesn’t lowercase it. Verified: `Archive.TAR.GZ` and `photo.JPG` fall back to octet-stream, while `photo.jpg.exe` incorrectly becomes `image/jpeg`. A dotless name also returns `undefined` rather than the documented empty string.
   *Recommended fix:* Extract the text after the last dot, lowercase it, and return `''` when there’s no extension.

2. *Unknown extensions can return inherited properties instead of MIME strings* — `src/content-type.js:11`
   The plain-object lookup includes prototype properties. Verified: `file.constructor` returns a function and `file.__proto__` returns an object, bypassing the octet-stream fallback.
   *Recommended fix:* Use an own-property check, a null-prototype lookup, or a `Map`.

All 3 existing tests pass, but they don’t cover these failures. Add regression tests for the examples above, including direct `contentType()` assertions.

No files changed.
